fix_description: Increase readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds and memory limits to allow database connection pool to initialize properly
fix_code:
readinessProbe:
  initialDelaySeconds: 30
  periodSeconds: 5
resources:
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi
    cpu: 500m

fix_description: Application crash due to uninitialized configuration. Ensure config file is mounted and environment variables are set before container startup
fix_code:
# Add config volume mount and init container
volumeMounts:
  - name: app-config
    mountPath: /etc/config
volumes:
  - name: app-config
    configMap:
      name: worker-service-config
initContainers:
  - name: config-check
    image: busybox
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'test -f /etc/config/app.yaml']

fix_description: Container running out of memory during batch processing. Increase memory limits and implement streaming/chunked processing instead of loading entire dataset into memory
fix_code:
resources:
  requests:
    memory: 512Mi
    cpu: 250m
  limits:
    memory: 2Gi
    cpu: 1000m

# Also update application to use chunked processing:
# BATCH_SIZE=1000
# STREAM_MODE=true
